stage.note: Only priced round found in press is the 2012 Kima Ventures seed investment (amount undisclosed). Company survived a court-supervised receivership (redressement judiciaire) in 2015-2016 and has since described itself as self-financed/profitable; no later priced VC round was found, so 'seed' is the last confirmed stage rather than a claim of ongoing VC backing.

last_round.quote: La jeune pousse en profite pour communiquer sur une levée de fonds réalisée au début de l'année 2012, auprès du fonds Kima Ventures, géré par Jérémie Berrebi et Xavier Niel.

note: Founded 2010 in Nantes by Quentin Adam (CEO) and Clément Nivolle (co-founder/CMO); a European PaaS provider still run as an independent, non-YC-affiliated company. It took a confidential seed check from Kima Ventures in early 2012 (9 employees at the time) but has not disclosed any subsequent priced funding round. The company entered a court-supervised 'redressement judiciaire' (receivership) in 2015 after a bad enterprise deal and management/investor misalignment, exited it in December 2016 having kept growing revenue throughout, and describes itself since as resilient/self-sustaining ('a fast-growing IT automation company'). No evidence of acquisition, IPO, or being a subsidiary of a larger group; no revenue/ARR or headcount figures could be confirmed.
